name: video_download
description: A video download tool that fetches a public video from a URL (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and hundreds of sites via yt-dlp) and saves the mp4 file inside the working folder only. Use whenever the user gives a video link that must be analyzed. Returns the saved workspace path plus video metadata (title, uploader, duration, resolution) so the next step can call video_analyze or video_transcribe on the saved file.

url.description: Public video page URL (http(s) only, e.g. TikTok/YouTube/Instagram link).

filename.description: Optional custom file name inside the working folder (single name, .mp4 added if missing).
